thread:
jordan_customer: Hey @elaine_support we started getting 400s from /v1/call with 'invalid function arguments' after upgrading the SDK. Error text: 'invalid function arguments: items: expected array' — billing spiked because the client retried automatically. Request id r-abc123

elaine_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the exact request payload and the runtime error you see? Which SDK + version?

jordan_customer: payload:
```json
{
  "tool": "createOrder",
  "args": {
    "order_id": "ord_001",
    "items": null,
    "customer": {"id": "cust_7"}
  }
}
```

runtime error:
```
invalid arguments: field 'items' expected array<string> but got null
```

SDK: redwood-js 2.7.1 — this started after upgrading from 2.6.x

sherman_eng: Thanks — looking. Quick question: is the schema for createOrder declaring `items` as a required array? Also which model/region are you on? If possible can you repro with curl so we can capture raw bytes.

jordan_customer: repro curl (same failure):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/call \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-xxx" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"tool":"createOrder","args":{"order_id":"ord_001","items":null}}'
```

region: us-west-2, model: rwd-3b-compat

deploy-bot: deploy cherry-pick/runtime-hotfix started by @sherman_eng — build 2026.03.17-1545 :rocket:

sherman_eng: Root cause summary: our runtime JSON-mode validator rejects `null` for fields typed as array. Historically some clients relied on `null` -> treated as empty list by downstream tooling. Two remediation paths: (A) hotfix runtime to coerce `null` -> `[]` for args when schema expects array; (B) patch SDK to avoid sending `null` for optional arrays. For backward-compatibility and to stop customer failures immediately, we'll push (A) as a hotfix then follow with an SDK update.

elaine_support: Escalating to billing_ops and eng on your behalf, @jordan_customer. For billing: we'll review the spike and refund token charges caused by automatic retries while we fix. ETA for hotfix ~2 hours, will post PR/patch link here.

jordan_customer: Confirmed workaround: sending "items": [] removes the error. Appreciate the quick response. :thumbsup:

sherman_eng: Follow-up: patch merged and linked: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/runtime/+/fix/null-array-coercion — will roll in the next patch window and monitor for regressions. :eyes:
